title: Recovery expiry regression must distinguish an interior-row deadline from the page-level deadline
outcome: The deterministic satellite recovery regression rejects removal of the per-row yield check while retaining the page-level check, and proves exact cursor continuation without elapsed wall-clock dependence.
acceptance: A scripted expiry at an interior row of a 100-row recovery page proves that recovery yields at that exact row and retains that row's exact cursor key; no real wait, timeout increase or automatic retry is added.

The next explicit recovery pass resumes without skipping or rescanning history and reaches the pending operation across the remaining pages; the original 150-history single-pass traversal assertion remains.
The test discriminates deleting the row-level deadline check while retaining the page-level deadline check, with source reasoning or a controlled mutation diagnostic documented.
